definitions.explanation: The physical and mental strength to do things actively.

examples.japanese: {精力|せいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧。
⟦{精力的|せいりょくてき}→精力的：20388_seiryokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{精力|せいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{衰|おとろ}える→衰える：04584_otoroeru⟧。

notes:
{精力|せいりょく} means energy, vigor, or vitality—the drive and stamina to pursue activities actively.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{精力的|せいりょくてき}→精力的：20388_seiryokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: energetically
- {精力|せいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour energy into
- {精力|せいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧: to devote energy to
- {精力|せいりょく}⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧: full of energy, vigorous
- {精力|せいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{衰|おとろ}える→衰える：04584_otoroeru⟧: one's energy declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{活力|かつりょく}→活力：05525_katsuryoku⟧: vitality (liveliness)
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧: physical strength/stamina
- ⟦{気力|きりょく}→気力：08515_kiryoku⟧: willpower, mental energy

USAGE:
{精力|せいりょく} can also refer to sexual vitality in some contexts.
